extracted.name: Air Fryer Loaded Chicken Taquitos
extracted.description: Crunchy creamy yummy goodness!! This recipe includes a creamy jalapeño cilantro sauce that put these taquitos over the top. Pair it with your favorite recipe for pico and guac and your favorite Mexican side dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 Boneless skinless chicken breast split in half
1/2 cup pickled jalapeños with pickling liquid
instruction_lines: Preheat air fryer to 390. Mix all Spices for chicken together and liberally season front and back of the chicken breast.
Drizzle olive oil in a pan over medium high heat. Cook chicken breast on both sides for 4-5minutes. Be sure to not over cook your chicken.
Chop chicken finally using a food processor or by hand if desired. Mix and shredded cheese.
Heat tortillas in a microwave for 60 seconds to make them more pliable. You may also heat them in a pan.
Place two tbs of chicken mixture inside of tortilla and roll tightly. Secure with a toothpick if needed. Lightly brush with olive oil.
Cook in air fryer for six minutes until golden brown.
Mix all ingredients for sauce in a food processor or blender. Season with salt and pepper to taste
Remove taquitos from air fryer. Top with jalapeño cilantro sauce guacamole and pico de gallo. Garnish with cojita cheese.
